parentNote.en: Every question is answered in the app. Each goal has a short home activity: say the words aloud together, and let your child guess first.
parentNote.ar: كل الأسئلة الطفل بيحلها جوه البرنامج، ولكل هدف نشاط قصير في البيت. قولوا الكلمات بصوت عالي مع بعض، وسيبوا طفلك يتوقع الأول.

steps.title: How to make a cup of juice
steps.explanation: Instructions tell us how to do something, step by step, in the right order.
steps.shortExplanation: Instructions tell us how to do something, step by step, in the right order.

steps.title: Bossy verbs

options.label: Some words are bossy. They tell you what to do: Sit down. Wash your hands.
Instructions must be in order. We use numbers, or First, Next, Then, Finally.
Many instructions start with a list called You will need.

steps.explanation: Instructions start with bossy verbs and go in order: First, Next, Then, Finally.
steps.shortExplanation: Instructions start with bossy verbs and go in order: First, Next, Then, Finally.

steps.title: Find the bossy verb
steps.prompt: Put toothpaste on it. Which word is the bossy verb?
steps.hint: Which word tells you what to do?
steps.explanation: Put is the bossy verb. It tells you what to do.
steps.shortExplanation: Put is the bossy verb. It tells you what to do.

source.answerKeyText: a Pick (up) • b Put • c Spit (out)

steps.title: Find the bossy verb
steps.prompt: Spit out the toothpaste. Which word is the bossy verb?
steps.explanation: Spit is the bossy verb. It comes first and tells you what to do.
steps.shortExplanation: Spit is the bossy verb. It comes first and tells you what to do.

source.answerKeyText: a Pick (up) • b Put • c Spit (out)

steps.title: a or an?
steps.prompt: Do we say a or an?
steps.hint: Does the word start with a, e, i, o or u? Say it aloud: an apple.
steps.explanation: Apple, egg and orange start with a vowel sound, so we say an.
steps.shortExplanation: Apple, egg and orange start with a vowel sound, so we say an.

source.answerKeyText: an apple • a party • an egg • a sweet • an orange • a present

steps.title: Juice in order
steps.prompt: Tap the steps in the right order.
steps.hint: What do you need before you can pour?
steps.explanation: First get a cup, then pour the juice, add a straw and drink it.
steps.shortExplanation: First get a cup, then pour the juice, add a straw and drink it.

source.answerKeyText: Get a cup 1 • Pour the juice 2 • Add a straw 3 • Drink it! 4

steps.title: How to do it
steps.prompt: Which ly word fits each instruction?

options.label: … close the door. The baby is asleep.

steps.hint: How do you carry water? How do you close a door when a baby sleeps?
steps.explanation: Carry the water carefully, and close the door quietly when the baby is asleep.
steps.shortExplanation: Carry the water carefully, and close the door quietly when the baby is asleep.

steps.title: Is it an instruction?
steps.hint: An instruction tells you what to do.
steps.explanation: Wash your hands and Shut the door tell you what to do.
steps.shortExplanation: Wash your hands and Shut the door tell you what to do.

steps.title: Cross the road
steps.prompt: Match each step to its time word.

options.label: find a safe place to cross.

steps.hint: What do you do before you look both ways?
steps.explanation: First find a safe place, next stand near the kerb, then look, finally cross.
steps.shortExplanation: First find a safe place, next stand near the kerb, then look, finally cross.

steps.title: A bossy verb
steps.prompt: … the ball. Which bossy verb fits?
steps.hint: What can you do to a ball?
steps.explanation: Kick the ball. Kick is a bossy verb.
steps.shortExplanation: Kick the ball. Kick is a bossy verb.

source.answerKeyText: For example: Kick / Throw the ball • Hang up your coat • Shut / Open the door

steps.title: A bossy verb
steps.prompt: … up your coat. Which bossy verb fits?
steps.hint: What do you do with your coat when you come home?
steps.explanation: Hang up your coat. Hang is a bossy verb.
steps.shortExplanation: Hang up your coat. Hang is a bossy verb.

source.answerKeyText: For example: Kick / Throw the ball • Hang up your coat • Shut / Open the door

steps.title: Wash your hands
steps.prompt: Tap the steps for washing your hands in order.
steps.hint: What do you do before you rub on soap?
steps.explanation: Wet your hands, rub on soap, then rinse and dry. Each starts with a bossy verb.
steps.shortExplanation: Wet your hands, rub on soap, then rinse and dry. Each starts with a bossy verb.

source.answerKeyText: Three numbered steps in order, each starting with a bossy verb — e.g. 1 Wet your hands. 2 Rub on soap. 3 Rinse and dry your hands.

steps.title: Mix the eggs
steps.prompt: In Mix the eggs, the word Mix is a…
steps.hint: Mix tells you what to do.
steps.explanation: Mix tells you what to do, so it is a bossy verb.
steps.shortExplanation: Mix tells you what to do, so it is a bossy verb.

steps.title: a or an?
steps.hint: Which one starts with a vowel sound?
steps.explanation: Egg starts with a vowel sound, so we say an egg.
steps.shortExplanation: Egg starts with a vowel sound, so we say an egg.

steps.title: The list
steps.prompt: The list of things you need is called…
steps.hint: It comes before the steps in a recipe.
steps.explanation: The list of things you need is called You will need.
steps.shortExplanation: The list of things you need is called You will need.

steps.title: In order
steps.hint: Can you eat the sandwich before you make it?
steps.explanation: Instructions must be in the right order, or they would be silly.
steps.shortExplanation: Instructions must be in the right order, or they would be silly.

steps.title: Slowly
steps.hint: Walk slowly. How do you walk?
steps.explanation: Slowly tells us how to do it. Words ending in ly tell us how.
steps.shortExplanation: Slowly tells us how to do it. Words ending in ly tell us how.

stickers.meaning: A verb that tells you what to do: Wash your hands.

goalActivities.text: Brush teeth together and say each step as an instruction: Pick up your toothbrush. Put toothpaste on it. Brush. Spit.
goalActivities.textAr: اغسلوا سنانكم مع بعض وقولوا كل خطوة كأنها أمر: Pick up your toothbrush و Put toothpaste on it و Brush و Spit.
goalActivities.safety: An adult supervises. An adult does any cutting: cut plastic has sharp edges, so cover them with tape.
goalActivities.safetyAr: لازم شخص كبير يكون موجود. الكبير هو اللي يقص: البلاستيك المقصوص حروفه حادة، فغطّوها بشريط لاصق.

goalActivities.text: Fill a shopping basket from the kitchen: an egg, an apple, an onion, a tomato, a spoon. Your child says a or an for each one.
goalActivities.textAr: املوا سلة من المطبخ: an egg و an apple و an onion و a tomato و a spoon. وطفلك يقول a ولا an لكل حاجة.

goalActivities.text: Cut four steps of a recipe apart on paper and mix them up. Your child puts them back in order, then you follow them together.
goalActivities.textAr: قصّوا أربع خطوات من وصفة على ورق ولخبطوها، وطفلك يرتبها، وبعدين تعملوها مع بعض.

goalActivities.textAr: ادّي تعليمات فيها كلمات ly وطفلك يمثّلها: Walk slowly و Clap quickly و Carry the cup carefully.

goalActivities.text: Go on a hunt for instruction signs: on a door, a bottle, a lift. Read the bossy verb together.

goalActivities.text: When you cross a road together, your child says the steps: First… Next… Then… Finally….
goalActivities.textAr: لما تعدّوا الشارع مع بعض، طفلك يقول الخطوات: First… و Next… و Then… و Finally….

goalActivities.text: Your child tells you three numbered steps for washing hands while you both do it at the sink.

homeActivities.text: Be a robot parent who does exactly what you are told. Your child gives you instructions to make a jam sandwich. Forget a step, and the robot gets it wrong!
homeActivities.textAr: اعمل نفسك روبوت بيعمل اللي يتقاله بالظبط، وطفلك يديك تعليمات تعمل ساندوتش مربى. لو نسي خطوة، الروبوت يغلط!
